content: In ongoing work, we are currently examining the use of our characterisation of incident reports to enable comparisons across healthcare organisations and also to monitor their change over time. This part of ongoing research requires the quantification of in-class text similarities and to dynamically manage the embedding of the reports through updates and recalculation of the vector embedding. Improvements in the process of robust graph construction are also part of our future work. Detecting anomalies in the data to decide whether newer topic clusters should be created, or providing online classification suggestions to users based on the text they input are some of the improvements we aim to add in the future to aid with decision support and data collection, and to potentially help fine-tune some of the predefined categories of the external classification.
